findings.summary: codex: cooldown trusted before session.save() — a record whose turn could no longer advance on disk (reads work, writes fail) recomputed 'cooling' every stop and silenced the nudge INDEFINITELY instead of failing open; fixed by persisting the bump before trusting cooldown state (save throws → turn undefined → fire)

codex: nudgedAtTurn values not runtime-validated — parseable-but-malformed values (999999, '1000', null) coerced into 'cooling' and failed CLOSED; fixed with finite-[0,turn] validation in cooling() plus load-time sanitization in session.ts

round 1: runStop e2e helper inherited KB_SESSION_ID from the developer environment, which would override both payload session_ids and falsely redden the per-session cooldown tests; fixed by clearing it in the helper env

codex: safeKey (src/backend.ts:69) maps distinct session ids lossily (session/a, session?a, session:a all -> session_a.json), so colliding ids share turn/cooldown state — PRE-EXISTING (ADR-0044 seam, 822b176, unchanged by this PR), harness UUIDs never collide; tracked as issue #273

test/stop-reminder.test.ts > decideStop — per-nudge cooldown > fires again once the cooldown window has elapsed
test/stop-reminder.test.ts > cli hook stop > cooldown: the same session is NOT re-nudged on the very next stop
